summary: Rail Vision Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 9, 2026 press release rebranding its existing MainLine and ShuntingYard products as TrackScout and YardFlow Flex, with no change to the underlying technology, pricing, or commercial terms disclosed. The filing is a routine product-marketing update, not a special situation; no transaction, stakeholder, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is presented. The first four paragraphs are incorporated by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements, which is an ordinary disclosure-breadth note. Nothing here alters capital structure, ownership, or control. Risk-arb angle: none; no event to trade.
